name: H20 B — Public catalogue and proposal generator

parameters.content: Firebase ID tokens are verified through accounts:lookup for all actions except public catalogue reads. AI actions (chat, event-request) enforce per-IP (SHA-256 hashed) and global hourly rate limits in the Data Table before calling Gemini. Select your Data Table in Read records, Insert claim, Re-read records after claim, Delete lost claim, Record rate limit and Save record, attach your Gemini credential, configure Google Cloud Gemini quota/budget caps, then publish.
